layout: Per-cat source rectangles in pet-atlas-frames.json; generated by scripts/map-pet-atlas.py from connected alpha components. 69 frames on shared 160x174 runtime canvases.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for an ORIGINAL macOS desktop pet BrowserPet. Use reference only for original gray-white cat character identity, not text or UI. Generate a TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG with a STRICT evenly spaced grid of 8 columns and 9 rows, 72 equal square cells, ideally 1536x1728 pixels (each cell 192x192). Every cell contains exactly one full-body original gray-white small cat, same size, consistent design and alignment, feet baseline consistent, 20 percent transparent padding per cell. NO TEXT, NO labels, NO lines, NO grid borders, NO background, NO shadows outside cat, NO additional animals or props except tiny expression marks inside cell.
Rows 0-6 are 8 frame seamless animation loops, left to right chronological:
row0 IDLE: small breathing and blink, calm seated front-facing pose, tiny changes only.
row1 RUN RIGHT: eight-frame full-body running cycle facing RIGHT, in place, no horizontal travel inside cell.
row2 RUN LEFT: same eight-frame run cycle facing LEFT.
row3 JUMP: small cheerful hop, crouch to airborne to landing, feet remain fully inside cells.
row4 WORKING: eager gentle running-in-place/front-facing motion, a compact energetic loop without jumping across cell boundaries.
row5 WAITING: attentive front-facing sit, small head tilts and a paw gesture.
row6 FAILED: concerned but friendly front-facing crouch, ears lowered then return, no large icons.
Rows7-8 are 16 STATIC GAZE directions: each cell same seated body facing front, change HEAD and EYES orientation only, evenly quantized directions around circle. row7 cells0..7 directions N, NNE, NE, ENE, E, ESE, SE, SSE; row8 cells0..7 S, SSW, SW, WSW, W, WNW, NW, NNW. Keep cat silhouette centered same scale. This grid is a runtime asset to be sliced programmatically, so exact regular layout matters. Maintain exactly EIGHT cats per row and NINE rows total. The final file must contain ALPHA transparency, not a checkerboard illustration. No drop shadows, labels, watermark, or UI.
runtimeCleanup: Keep the complete largest connected cat silhouette and its one-pixel antialiased edge; remove disconnected foreign pieces. The original generated PNG is unchanged.
